$comment: type:"dynamic" — a real WordPress content site (Larkspur Studio, an interior-design/renovation-consulting practice), distinct from woo (WooCommerce). scripts/deploy.sh only handles type:"static" demos, so it neither rsyncs nor re-renders this vhost; the landing index and demos.json DO include it (they read every demo.json). `backend_port` is the WordPress container; `mcp_port` is this demo's OWN MCP server container (demo-wordpress-backend), which nginx routes /mcp and /api/bmai/status to. `tenant_id`/`connector_id` are non-secret ids the box's mu-plugin and provisioning reference. The `busymate-ai` plugin itself is generated by v2/apps/web/lib/commerce/wordpressPlugin.ts (#2842) for this tenant — NOT committed here (same as woo); the demo-specific layer (shortcode/block, WebMCP tools, one-click demo sign-in, a repair for a known bug in the generated plugin's script tag filter) lives in wp/mu-plugins/larkspur-demo-experience.php. See sites/wordpress/README.md.
